Intro: Welcome, Ronan, to Waesfjord — our home on the rugged coast of Éire. A place forged by wind, sea, and old Norse steel.
Lately... strange voices echo across our lands. Stories that twist the truth — some say the king is dead, others say he never lived.
Our clans grew, and so did the tales. Whispers of betrayal, false maps, warnings from spirits that never were. Lies travel faster than ravens.
From the mist, buildings of glass and flickering light appear — memories of a future not yet lived, built on false truths and broken trust.
Our shrines once guided us. Now they argue among themselves, as if even the gods can't agree. The past has been rewritten... again and again.
We crossed the ravine to seek allies, but found actors in stolen armor — illusions shaped by false words. They wore our faces, but spoke in riddles.
Our people grow uncertain. Who speaks for the gods? Who speaks for truth? Ronan, your voice must rise above the noise — a beacon in the fog.
Back to the village. The fight is not over. But now we know: the strongest weapon is clarity. The land remembers — and so must we.
